arm_solver_web_subagent.who: one screen-class solver-web subagent, the same agent definition the retrieval-enabled arm will use
arm_solver_web_subagent.what_happened: The subagent was dispatched with the frozen probe and terminated before completing any probe call: 'Agent terminated early due to an API error: You've hit your session limit' (rate_limit, HTTP 429). It emitted no fetch result and no search result.
arm_solver_web_subagent.finding: NONE. This arm produced no evidence. It is not evidence that the subagent environment matches the orchestrator, and it is not evidence that it differs.
arm_solver_web_subagent.rerun: Re-runnable at zero cost to the production budget once the session limit resets. It remains the only direct evidence about the solver's own egress path.

correction_to_the_prior_turn: The source-verification turn reported that fetches to en.wikipedia.org and www.bls.gov were refused 'while WebSearch worked normally', which implied a domain-selective block. The frozen probe shows the block is total: example.com is refused too. The observation was right; the implied scope was wrong.

interpretation_under_the_frozen_rules.conclusion: In the orchestrator environment the retrieval capability is SEARCH-ONLY: search-result snippets and extracted page text, with no ability to open a named page. This is a weaker intervention than unrestricted web access and must be named as such wherever the word 'retrieval' appears.
interpretation_under_the_frozen_rules.what_is_still_open: Whether the solver-web subagent shares this egress path. The architectural expectation is that it does - same container, same egress proxy, same WebFetch and WebSearch implementations - but the frozen design deliberately required a measurement rather than an expectation, and that measurement has not been obtained.
interpretation_under_the_frozen_rules.transfer_rule: Until the subagent arm returns data, the observed blockage is NOT transferred to the treatment claim as a measured fact. It is carried as the expected-but-unverified case, and the treatment scope below is written to be honest under either outcome.

no_analysis_conditioning: This probe does not drop, reweight, screen or condition any production item. No item is excluded because a key source was unreachable or a domain was blocked. See docs/EXP004_STAGE0A_M_SPECIFICATION.md.
